description: China 2000 railways is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Beijing Hua tong ren shi chang xin xi you xian ze ren gong si, University of Michigan. China Data Center. This datalayer contains lines representing China railroads/railways for 2000. This datalayer is part of the China 2000 county population census data set produced by the All China Marketing Research Co. and distributed by the University of Michigan, China Data Center (2003). Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: No part of this data product is allowed to be reproduced or re-distributed to any other parties without permission.. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
